description: Returns the identifiers of the products in the free UK daily 212-item basket (CC BY 4.0): retailer, retailer product id and barcodes (`ean`, empty where the basket holds none, as for Aldi), for one day, sorted, with paging. Use it to find what lookup_basket_prices can look up. No names, brands or prices: pass the ids or barcodes to lookup_basket_prices.

date.description: Day, e.g. "2026-10-08". Omit for the latest day loaded.

limit.description: Products per page, 1 to 100. Omit for 100.

offset.description: Products to skip, from 0. Use nextOffset from the previous page. Example: 100.

retailers.description: Only these retailers, e.g. ["tesco", "asda"]. Omit for all four.

name: list_basket_products
title: Product identifiers in the daily basket
